hint.text: Personification is when an idea or thing is given human-like or living qualities.
hint.label: Personification

atoms.b: I can hear the ((burger)) calling my name.
atoms.sound: I can hear the burger calling my name.

atoms.a: Which human trait is given to the burger?
What does this figure of speech mean?
b: The person does not like the burger.
